violations.description: Committed personal Git credentials in .git-credentials file.
violations.recommendation: Remove the file from git history and use git credential helpers.
Remove the private key, revoke it, and rotate credentials.
Remove the file from git and use environment variables for database configuration.

violations.description: Committed environment variables containing sensitive secrets in .env.
violations.recommendation: Remove the .env file from the repository and use a .env.example template.
Use an environment variable to store the SECRET_KEY.

violations.description: Committed sensitive keys in S3 configuration file.
violations.recommendation: Remove from git and use environment variables or secret management services.

violations.description: Committed sensitive configuration files that should be ignored (.ssh, .docker, etc.).
violations.evidence: .ssh/id_rsa, .docker/.dockercfg, db/.pgpass are all tracked in the repository.
violations.recommendation: Update .gitignore to exclude all sensitive and local configuration files.
